scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d='android/app/src/main/assets/public/models';if(fs.existsSync(d))for(const x of fs.readdirSync(d,{recursive:true}))if(x.endsWith('terrain.i16'))fs.rmSync(p.join(d,x),{force:true});" && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d='android/app/src/main/assets/public/models';if(fs.existsSync(d))for(const x of fs.readdirSync(d,{recursive:true}))if(x.endsWith('terrain.i16'))fs.rmSync(p.join(d,x),{force:true});" && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
